newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products down - gasoline down $4-5.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products down - gasoline down $4-5.

text.p: NWE oil products were lower on Friday.
Gasoline lost $4-5 a tonne as the U.S. futures rally stalled. Eurograde barges traded at $226.50, off from the high seen on Thursday of $230.

Gas oil slipped $2.50 a tonne, in line with September IPE which settled at $171.50. A cargo of EN590 moved unchanged at a $5.25 premium to the screen. Heating oil differentials were notionally stable in inactive trade.
